title: Experiment Designer
description:
A Windows desktop application for reproducible animal allocation in livestock trials, with sex composition controls, ranked body-weight subgroup balancing for RCBD, prepared pen/cage layouts, immutable history and concise Excel reports. Version 1.1.7 adds English, Spanish (Spain) and Spanish (Mexico), a dedicated Settings dialog for language and appearance, reviewed interface/report wording, translated offline guides and a multilingual installation wizard with license, destination and shortcut choices. Existing allocation rules and study history are preserved.

Tutorial: Watch the Experiment Designer tutorial on YouTube.

How to cite: If you use Experiment Designer in research, publications, reports or presentations, please cite the software version used. Author: Emmanuel O. Alagbe. Version 1.1.7 (2026), Experiment Designer [Computer software]. Use the version DOI shown on this record; the all-versions DOI is https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23698895.

This record archives source code. Download the ready-to-run Windows package and checksum from GitHub Releases.
